title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
slides: Anthropic says self-building AI is near. How near?
Its own researchers flag recursive self-improvement risk
But the company admits it lacks tools to measure it
Teams deploying agents now inherit that blind spot
Ask your vendor: what RSI metric do you track?
thread_text:
1. The blind spot is already yours

Anthropic's own researchers warn recursive self-improvement is near — and admit they can't measure it. Anyone deploying AI agents today inherits that gap.

2. What recursion actually means

Self-building AI means the model improves itself faster than humans can review. The team that spots it first isn't the one that ships it.

3. The test they don't have

Anthropic says it lacks tools to detect when an AI starts rewriting its own code. That means no early warning — for them or for you.

4. Your vendor won't volunteer this

If the lab building the model can't track recursive self-improvement, no downstream deployer can. The risk travels down the contract, not the codebase.

5. One question, before you sign

Ask your AI vendor: what metric do you track for recursive self-improvement? If they can't name one, you're the test case.
